subject: Box plot showing no quartile values or confidence intervals

messages.author: d8fe91e28c0cde45
messages.subject: Box plot showing no quartile values or confidence intervals
parts:
Good Day,

I am trying to generate a boxplot for my categorical variable, with three levels (vegetation type). However, the interquartile range is not displayed in the boxplots (attached).

The model psi(veg_type)p(.) was the best model based on AIC scores, hence I wanted to generate a boxplot showing the influence of vegetation type/s on rusty-spotted genet occupancy. I encountered the same problem when I wanted to generate boxplots to present the influence of vegetation type of African civet and serval (my other two study species)

Your assistance or comments would be greatly appreciated.

I  also attached a screenshot of my covariate dataset,  detection/non-detection dataset for the rusty spotted genet, and R-code used.

Thank you,

R-code

fold<-"C:/Users/Chanelle Potgieter/OneDrive/Wildlife Management/NLB795/Data Analysis/Detection_History_RSG_Kaingo.csv"

  getwd()

detection_history <- read.csv("C:/Users/Chanelle Potgieter/OneDrive/Wildlife Management/NLB795/Data Analysis/Detection_History_RSG_Kaingo.csv")

head(detection_history)

 sample.unmarkedFrame_simple <- unmarkedFrameOccu( 
    y = as.matrix(detection_history)) 

 site_cov <- read.csv("C:/Users/Chanelle Potgieter/OneDrive/Wildlife Management/NLB795/Data Analysis/COV_Kaingo_Final.csv")
 
  any(is.na(site_cov))
  # Convert the Veg_Type column to a factor
  site_cov$Veg_Type <- factor(site_cov$Veg_Type)
 
  str(site_cov)
  # Scale numeric covariates
  numeric_columns <- c("RAI_Leopard", "RAI_Jackal", "RAI_Lion", "RAI_Human")
 
  site_cov[numeric_columns] <- scale(site_cov[numeric_columns])
 
  #Rebuild the unmarkedFrameOccu object with the scaled covariates
  sample.unmarkedFrame_cov <- unmarkedFrameOccu(
    y = as.matrix(detection_history),  # Detection history matrix (0's and 1's)
    siteCovs = site_cov  # Updated site covariates with scaled values
  )
  # View the scaled data
  head(site_cov)
 
  # Summarize the unmarkedFrame object
  summary(sample.unmarkedFrame_cov)

occ2 <- occu(~1 ~ Veg_Type, data = sample.unmarkedFrame_cov)

site_cov$Veg_Type <- factor(site_cov$Veg_Type, levels = c("CSB", "WMB", "WSB"))
 
  predict_occ_veg <- cbind(
    predict(occ2, newdata = data.frame(Veg_Type = site_cov$Veg_Type), type = "state"),
    site_cov
  )
 
  library(ggplot2)
  
  ggplot(predict_occ_veg, aes(x = Veg_Type, y = Predicted)) +
    geom_boxplot(fill = "blue") +
    labs(x = "Vegetation Type", y = "Probability of use") +
    theme_classic()
